# Instruction layout fixtures

These synthetic project files pin the recognition and migration contract in
ADR-0036. They are test data, never instructions for this repository. `before/`
is the original project input; `after/` is a documented approved outcome, not
an executed model migration. An absent instruction file is intentionally absent.
`expected.json` names layout, required behavior and diagnostic. Missing-policy
models unavailable installed evidence separately from the structural layout.

The tests prove structural recognition, preservation and documented output.
They do not execute a skill, infer model compliance, authorize migration or
establish automatic host ingress, policy reads or application. Declined legacy
files retain their policy bodies byte-for-byte; successful migration outputs
carry no policy body. Legacy completion reporting uses the status skill's
bounded installed-source exception and remains read-only.
